arenaTheme.text: Plain light grey room with a couple of small ceiling turrets. Background shall be of various size metal gears

hazardsLayer1.text: Turrets aim at player to nearest 45°, all firing simultaneous short 3-bullet bursts of slightly slow bullets; 15s cooldown.

hazardsLayer2.text: Same number of turrets; aim within nearest 22.5°; slightly reduced cooldown.

hazardsLayer3.text: Same number of turrets; aim within nearest 11.25°; further reduced cooldown.

attackLayer1.text: Moves back and forth on the stage, occasionally stopping to fire a 3 bullet spread with mild auto-aim after a short time, dealing small damage.

attackLayer2.text: Moves back and forth across the stage, occasionally stopping to fire either a 3 bullet spread directly forward with mild auto-aim after a short time or aim directly at the player and shoot a string of 5 bullets that do not auto aim. Boss stops tracking the player during the 5-bullet string, aiming where the player was at the time the first of 5 bullets comes out.

attackLayer3.text: Moves back and forth across the stage, occasionally stopping to fire either a set of 3 3-bullet spread directly forward with mild auto-aim after a short time or aim directly at the player, tracking the player continuously while shooting a string of 5-10 bullets that do not auto aim, either way, dealing small damage.

weaponDescription.text: Fires a neutral bullet with scalable fire rate; very low base damage.

lv3.text: Mild auto-aim. 3-bullet burst shot, like a rifle. Short cool down

lv6.text: Main bullet does not auto-aim; main bullet splits into 3 fragments after a brief time; fragments have moderate auto-aim. Short cooldown

lv10.text: full-auto with high fire rate,  does not split; strong auto-aim. 0.125 cooldown

bossAppliedAttribute.text:
Hot (boss/hazard-sourced): applies only to environment; area is 'red hot'. add a low transparency red hue that becomes more transparent as the effect diminishes; moderate damage/flinch/knockback on touch, scaling down until Hot subsides. Hot affect shall last for 5s after the source that applied it has concluded.
Burn: the player is on fire. Deal very mild damage very rapidly, while rapidly diminishing. No flinch or knockback.

weaponAppliedAttribute.text:
Hot: applies only to environment; area is 'red hot'. add a low transparency red hue that becomes more transparent as the effect diminishes; moderate damage/flinch/knockback on touch, scaling down until Hot subsides. Hot affect shall last for 5s after the source that applied it has concluded. Does not affect player in any way.
Burn: the enemy is on fire. Deal very mild damage very rapidly, while rapidly diminishing. No flinch or knockback.

arenaTheme.text: Silhouette of a faintly glowing active volcano as the background. A few short platforms phase in and out in random places throughout the entire fight as shelter. Never shall all airborne platforms simultaneously have Hot.

hazardsLayer1.text: Brief screen shake → occasional player-width hot flaming rocks slowly fall from top of screen, crumbling on contact with the floor or platforms, leaving Hot there for a few seconds. Moderate damage and applies Burn on player contact. Cycle repeats every 20 seconds or so.

hazardsLayer2.text: Slightly more overt screen shake → slightly more rocks on screen, slightly bigger, falling slightly faster.

attackLayer1.text: Launches several bouncing fireballs toward the player that climb up walls and leave hot trails.

attackLayer2.text: Fewer fireballs, but higher bounce heights and alternating firing angles.

attackLayer3.text: Same as Layer 2; additionally the boss jumps up to a small platform just for himself a few seconds before the screen shakes, the red pixels of the background ebb rapidly, then the entire floor fills with lava, slowly, up to about one default player height; the lava recedes after 30 seconds, leaving Hot on the ground. Rocks shall not fall onto the platforms while the lava is up — the other platforms are already Hot, and there always needs to be somewhere safe for the player to stand.

weaponDescription.text: Throws a small low-apogee bouncing fireball along the ground; applies Hot to ground or burn to enemy on contact for a scalable time. High Fireball contact damage, which is separate from burn DPS. Player immune to player created hot and burn. Hot or burn do not stack with itself, but resets their respective durations.

lv1.text: Short travel distance; up to 1 on screen; 0.5s Hot duration.

lv3.text: 1s Hot duration on ground; slight increase in travel distance.

lv6.text: Adds a second fireball launched simultaneously on a slightly taller, much wider arc, contacting the ground shortly after the first, approximately where the first is projected to terminate, then continuing its own equal travel distance. Up to 2 on screen; Hot does not stack.

lv10.text: Combined effective travel shall be full screen (half for each fireball); fireballs pierce through all enemies, applying 2s Burn to each on contact. Up to 2 wheels on screen; player leaves a trail of Hot attribute for 1s on any surface contacted

palette.text: Blue primary; light brown secondary. Blue reads as Water and keeps clear of Quake and Granite, which the original light-brown primary collided with.

weaponAppliedAttribute.text: Wet: the surface or enemy has been soaked in water, reducing contact friction and visually indicated by an initially low transparency blue hue that fades until the attribute has expired. Lasts 10 seconds.

hazardsLayer1.text:
Heavy rain pouring straight down top-to-bottom, applies a continuous directional force vector / velocity bias that pushes player in the direction of the rain.
Steady, powerful water flows from portholes in the upper left and upper right corners of the stage. The water cascades down the walls and across the floor toward a grate-covered central drain/pit that all water drains into. Floor water should be knee-deep with strong inward-flowing currents that visibly pull toward the center.
Implement appropriate 2D physics: the flowing water applies a moderate continuous directional force / velocity bias that drags Mega Man toward the central drain (stronger on the ground, weaker in the air). a damaging spike ball sits on top the grate that the player should avoid. Combine with the diagonal storm rain push for layered pressing pressure the player must resist."

hazardsLayer2.text:
Heavy rain cycling through one of 3 directions (top-to-bottom, diagonal down+left, diagonal down+right) applies a continuous directional force vector / velocity bias that pushes Mega Man in the direction of the rain.
Steady, powerful water flows from portholes in the upper left and upper right corners of the stage. The water cascades down the walls and across the floor toward a grate-covered deadly central drain/pit that all water drains into. Floor water should be knee-deep with strong inward-flowing currents that visibly pull toward the center.
Implement appropriate 2D physics: the flowing water applies a moderate continuous directional force / velocity bias that drags Mega Man toward the central drain (stronger on the ground, weaker in the air). Touching the grate pit deals damage.

hazardsLayer3.text: [DRAFT] Rain from all three directions in rapid succession with no settled beat. Both portholes run at full pressure; floor water rises to mid-shin and the inward current roughly doubles, so holding station away from the drain takes constant input.

attackLayer1.text: Slow-moving high-pressure water cannons fire water in discrete angled arcs at random times; no damage on contact, but pushes the player in the direction of the water's travel and blocks player bullets. Once the attack reaches the ground it continues it's travel until it reaches a drain, pushes the player back; no damage.

attackLayer2.text: [DRAFT] Two cannons fire in alternating arcs so the pushes cross, and a landed jet now sweeps along the floor in the direction it fell rather than travelling straight to the nearest drain.

attackLayer3.text: [DRAFT] Three cannons; one fires straight down from the ceiling to cut the room in half. Jets persist noticeably longer on the floor, so two crossing currents can be live at once.

weaponDescription.text: Stand still firing a continuous water stream dealing very low but highly frequent damage. Pushes the enemy with faster enemies slightly pushing through, and slower enemies getting pushed backwards

lv1.text: Short travel distance; very low base damage.

lv3.text: Angle the attack diagonally with directional inputs. Increase travel distance accordingly.

lv6.text: Water stream now affected by gravity but travels significantly further overall.

lv10.text: Stream replaced with a semi-rapid water balloon style grenade launcher with small water-based explosions on contact with any enemy.

arenaTheme.text: [DRAFT] High-voltage substation interior: exposed bus bars, insulator stacks, and caged floor panels. Background is a wall of transformers whose indicator lamps pulse in time with the hazard cycle.

hazardsLayer1.text: [DRAFT] Floor panels electrify in a slow left-to-right sweep, one panel at a time, telegraphed by a lamp on the panel a moment before it energises. Contact deals moderate damage and a short Stun.

hazardsLayer2.text: [DRAFT] Same sweep, faster, plus overhead conductors that drop a vertical arc at fixed positions on a regular beat. The conductors are inert between arcs and can be stood under safely.

hazardsLayer3.text: [DRAFT] The sweep runs in both directions at once, meeting in the middle. Arcs now chain between conductors, briefly electrifying the air between two of them rather than only the ground beneath.

attackLayer1.text: Fires up to 5 sequential zigzag lightning bolts that bounce and arc on contact with surfaces or the player. Damage and size decrease at every bounce.

attackLayer2.text: [DRAFT] Bolts increase to 7 and gain a longer bounce life, and the boss fires a second volley on a shallower angle before the first has finished, so two zigzag paths overlap.

attackLayer3.text: [DRAFT] Bolts no longer lose size on bounce, only damage. Between volleys the boss discharges into the floor, briefly energising every panel the last bolt touched.

weaponDescription.text: Fixed-range electric burst with typical fire rate and base damage that chains to nearby enemies with diminishing damage.

lv1.text: 0 chains; 1s stun on first enemy contact.

lv3.text: Chain damage to 1 additional enemy, who does not get stunned.

lv6.text: 2s stun on first enemy contact; chain damage to a total of 2 additional enemies, stunned 0.5s.

lv10.text: Chain damage hits all enemies near the first enemy contacted; all stunned 4s.

arenaTheme.text: [DRAFT] Overgrown greenhouse with a shattered glass roof; light shafts fall in bands. Thick root mass banks the left and right walls, which the vines emerge from.

hazardsLayer1.text: [DRAFT] Thorned creepers grow slowly across the floor from both walls, covering ground over about ten seconds before retracting. Standing on a covered tile deals light repeating damage.

hazardsLayer2.text: [DRAFT] Creepers grow faster and now climb the walls to about half height, so wall-adjacent footing is unsafe too. A few seed pods drop from the roof and burst into a short-lived thorn patch where they land.

hazardsLayer3.text: [DRAFT] Creepers cover the floor almost entirely, leaving a slowly wandering clear channel that the player must track and stay inside. Seed pods fall on a continuous cycle.

attackLayer1.text: Shoots a pair of large straight vines directly at the player's current location. On hit: constrict for several seconds, reel the player in, then toss diagonally to the far wall — heavy damage on wall contact. On miss: pulls the boss to that point and fires again, up to 3 times before a cooldown.

attackLayer2.text: [DRAFT] Fires three vines in a fan rather than a pair, and on a miss the boss reels itself to the ceiling instead of to the miss point, attacking downward on the next pass.

attackLayer3.text: [DRAFT] On a successful grab the toss now aims at the nearest thorn-covered ground rather than the far wall. On a miss the vines stay embedded for a few seconds and act as temporary walls that block shots.

weaponDescription.text: Stand still while shooting a directional-input whip-like vine that reels in enemies then immediately throws them back as projectiles. Moderately slow attack speed.

lv1.text: Short reach; can only reel in and damage minions; does not toss or constrict them.

lv3.text: Increased reach. On enemy contact: perform the attack as described. Else if on the ground and contacting the outer 20% of a platform: grapple on top of that platform. If in the air and contacting a platform or ceiling: swing forward in the current direction, then release.

lv10.text: Now constricts mini-bosses and applies DPS for 5 seconds. Now throws minions as high-damage projectiles.

weaponAppliedAttribute.text: Freeze (shield break on minion contact; icicles freeze). Functionally same as stun/constrict; elementally correct colors flash.

arenaTheme.text: [DRAFT] Collapsed refrigeration hall. Frost-rimed pipes overhead, a floor of cracked ice over dark water, and a background of frozen machinery.

hazardsLayer1.text: [DRAFT] Icicles form on the ceiling pipes and fall after a visible growth tell. They shatter on impact and leave a slick patch that reduces contact friction for a few seconds.

hazardsLayer2.text: [DRAFT] More icicles, forming faster, and the floor slick left behind lasts noticeably longer so patches begin to join up.

hazardsLayer3.text: [DRAFT] A section of floor freezes over entirely and stays slick until the layer cycle ends, while icicles continue to fall onto it.

attackLayer1.text: Blizzard animation freezes all surfaces making them slippery, then drops icicles from above while the boss is protected by projectile-reflecting armor. Armor, blizzard and icicles subside during cooldown.

attackLayer2.text: [DRAFT] The blizzard now also pushes the player toward one wall for its duration, and the reflective armour holds through the whole icicle drop instead of subsiding partway.

attackLayer3.text: [DRAFT] Two blizzard cycles run back to back with no gap between them. During the second the boss slides along the frozen floor, so the armoured body is also a moving obstacle.

weaponDescription.text: Forms a large shield of ice in front of the player while the attack button is pressed. Short cooldown if released; long cooldown if destroyed by damage.

lv1.text: Shield blocks the equivalent of 3 minion attacks; breaks and freezes the opponent if contacting a minion instead.

lv3.text: Releasing attack before the shield breaks releases 3 small icicles (moderate cooldown) doing 1/3 damage each; they freeze.

lv6.text: Releasing attack before the shield breaks releases 5 small icicles (moderate cooldown) doing 1/3 damage each; they freeze.

lv10.text: Standing still briefly while holding attack forms ice armor that reflects projectiles and removes all incoming damage and knockback. Player cannot otherwise attack until the button is released.

arenaTheme.text: [DRAFT] Underground fight pit: chain-link cage walls, a stained mat floor, and a background of stacked crowd barriers and hanging lamps.

hazardsLayer1.text: [DRAFT] Weighted training bags swing across the room on ceiling rails at a steady pace, dealing knockback and light damage. Their path is fixed and learnable.

hazardsLayer2.text: [DRAFT] Two bags on crossing paths, moving faster, plus a section of floor mat that gives way into a shallow pit for a few seconds at a time.

hazardsLayer3.text: [DRAFT] Three bags at speed, and the ceiling rails now change direction mid-swing so the pattern has to be read live rather than memorised.

attackLayer1.text: Teleports close and performs rapid punches + uppercut launcher.

attackLayer2.text: [DRAFT] Adds a guard stance between combos that reflects the first shot it takes, and the uppercut launcher now chases upward once before the boss lands.

attackLayer3.text: [DRAFT] The combo can be cancelled into a second teleport mid-string, so the boss finishes the string from a different side than it started.

weaponDescription.text: Close-range powerful punch with knockback and damage reduction during attack animations. Tap attack for a quick low-damage mini-dash combo-starter jab; long-press attack 0.4s for a combo finisher.

lv1.text: 2 jabs, or 1 jab and one combo finisher.

lv3.text: [DRAFT] Jab chain extends to three hits; the third hit staggers. Long-press finisher gains a short forward lunge.

lv6.text: [DRAFT] Finisher launches the target upward, opening a juggle. Damage reduction during the animation increases.

lv10.text: [DRAFT] Finisher becomes a full dash-through that passes between enemies, hitting every one it crosses and ending in the launcher.

bossAppliedAttribute.text: Lingering poison clouds drain health over time and reduce player speed.

weaponAppliedAttribute.text: Poisoned: faint purple hue; DPS applied much less often (~every 3 seconds); causes flinch.

arenaTheme.text: [DRAFT] Chemical processing floor: corroded vats, drip lines and grated walkways over a sump. Background is a bank of pressure tanks weeping green.

hazardsLayer1.text: [DRAFT] Overhead drip lines leak at fixed points onto the floor, building small corrosive pools that apply Poisoned on contact and evaporate after several seconds.

hazardsLayer2.text: [DRAFT] More leak points, building pools faster, plus a low toxic haze that sits in the bottom few pixels of the room and applies Poisoned while stood in it.

hazardsLayer3.text: [DRAFT] The haze rises to about knee height and drifts slowly across the room, so the safe ground moves rather than the player simply avoiding fixed spots.

attackLayer1.text: Releases lingering poison clouds that drain health over time and reduce player speed.

attackLayer2.text: [DRAFT] Clouds are released in an arc rather than dropped in place, and now linger long enough for two to be present at once.

attackLayer3.text: [DRAFT] On release the clouds slowly drift toward the player instead of staying put, and a popped cloud leaves a corrosive pool where it dispersed.

weaponDescription.text: Sprays a cone of poison that damages over time and weakens enemies. Per-level scaling: larger cloud + stronger DoT.

lv1.text: [DRAFT] Short cone, low DoT; Poisoned lasts a few seconds and does not stack.

lv3.text: [DRAFT] Wider cone and longer Poisoned duration; the cone now passes through the first enemy it hits.

lv6.text: Lv6+: clouds can be detonated for burst damage.

lv10.text: Poisoned enemies drop health pickups when killed.

arenaTheme.text: [DRAFT] Deep excavation site: layered rock strata walls, timber shoring, and a background of stalled drilling rigs.

hazardsLayer1.text: [DRAFT] The ground fissures at telegraphed points and a rock pillar rises, dealing damage on the way up and remaining as a solid obstacle until it sinks again.

hazardsLayer2.text: [DRAFT] Pillars rise in pairs, and some now rise from the ceiling downward so the safe lane is a gap rather than a floor position.

hazardsLayer3.text: [DRAFT] A rolling wave of pillars crosses the room end to end, forcing continuous movement rather than choosing a spot to stand.

attackLayer1.text: Causes screen-wide tremors and rising rock pillars.

attackLayer2.text: [DRAFT] The stomp now sends two shockwaves in both directions, and the tremor briefly disables the player's footing so a jump has to be timed before the shake, not during it.

attackLayer3.text: [DRAFT] The stomp collapses part of the ceiling, adding falling debris to the shockwave, and pillars raised by the arena hazard are shattered into projectiles by the wave.

weaponDescription.text: Ground-pound that creates shockwaves and stuns nearby enemies. Per-level scaling: shockwave size + stun duration.

lv1.text: [DRAFT] Ground-pound on landing from a jump; small shockwave both directions, brief Stun on contact.

lv3.text: [DRAFT] Larger shockwave and longer Stun; the wave now climbs low obstacles instead of stopping at them.

lv6.text: Lv5+: can break certain floors or reveal hidden paths.

lv10.text: Max: super stomp that causes falling debris from the ceiling.

arenaTheme.text: [DRAFT] Open turbine deck at altitude: no side walls, only railings, with slow cloud layers passing behind and a vast rotor turning in the background.

hazardsLayer1.text: [DRAFT] A steady crosswind pushes the player toward one railing, reversing direction on a slow, clearly telegraphed cycle.

hazardsLayer2.text: [DRAFT] The wind gusts rather than holding steady — short, strong bursts strong enough to break a jump arc, separated by calm.

hazardsLayer3.text: [DRAFT] Gusts alternate with vacuum pockets that pull toward the rotor, so the player is fighting force in both directions within one cycle.

attackLayer1.text: Creates tornadoes that suck the player in and launch them upward.

attackLayer2.text: [DRAFT] Two smaller tornadoes at once on crossing paths, and the boss dives through one of them to close distance.

attackLayer3.text: [DRAFT] A single large vortex parks in the centre of the room and pulls continuously while the boss fires wind blades from the edge, so the fight becomes about holding position.

weaponDescription.text: Creates a controllable mini-tornado that lifts enemies and carries projectiles. Per-level scaling: bigger/longer tornado + movement speed while controlling it.

lv1.text: [DRAFT] Small tornado, short duration, lifts minions only.

lv3.text: [DRAFT] Larger and longer; the tornado now carries enemy projectiles that enter it.

lv6.text: Lv7+: can ride your own tornado for limited flight.

lv10.text: [DRAFT] The tornado becomes steerable in flight and returns carried projectiles at whoever fired them.

hazardsLayer1.text: [DRAFT] Sections of floor lose gravity on a slow cycle, telegraphed by the panel dimming; standing in one lifts the player and drops them when it ends.

hazardsLayer2.text: [DRAFT] More panels, cycling faster, and some invert to heavy gravity instead — jumps out of them are much shorter.

hazardsLayer3.text: [DRAFT] The whole room alternates between low and heavy gravity, with the panels only marking where the effect is strongest.

attackLayer1.text: Levitates the player and drops them from height while firing homing psychic orbs.

attackLayer2.text: [DRAFT] Levitation now sweeps the player sideways before dropping them, and the homing orbs fire in a ring rather than a stream.

attackLayer3.text: [DRAFT] The boss holds the player suspended while orbs converge, releasing only when an orb connects or the hold times out.

lv1.text: [DRAFT] One slow homing orb at a time; steerable while the attack button is held.

lv3.text: [DRAFT] Stronger homing and faster travel; the orb survives one terrain contact instead of dispersing.

lv10.text: Ultimate: brief mind control on weak enemies.

hazardsLayer2.text: [DRAFT] Cells hatch in clusters, and the resin floor now slows movement in patches where a sac has burst.

hazardsLayer3.text: [DRAFT] Hatching is continuous from both walls, and the ceiling drops sacs that burst into slowing resin where they land.

attackLayer1.text: Releases bug drones that home in and explode on contact.

attackLayer2.text: [DRAFT] Drones are released in a wave that spreads before homing, and a drone that misses circles once and makes a second pass.

attackLayer3.text: [DRAFT] The boss splits into a drone cloud and reforms elsewhere in the room, taking reduced damage while dispersed.

lv3.text: [DRAFT] Three allies with a longer duration; they now prioritise whatever the player last damaged.

lv10.text: Lv9: bugs form a temporary shield or kamikaze explosion wave.

arenaTheme.text: [DRAFT] Volcanic caldera rim: basalt columns, a glowing fissure crossing the floor, and a background of ash cloud lit from below.

hazardsLayer1.text: [DRAFT] The floor fissure vents in bursts at telegraphed points, each vent a brief vertical jet dealing moderate damage.

hazardsLayer2.text: [DRAFT] More vents in quicker succession, and the fissure widens so the safe standing area either side narrows.

hazardsLayer3.text: [DRAFT] Vents fire in a travelling sequence along the fissure, sweeping the room end to end.

attackLayer2.text: [DRAFT] The beam now sweeps in both directions across a single pass, and fireballs are released along its path rather than before it.

attackLayer3.text: [DRAFT] The boss takes flight for the beam, sweeping from above so there is no crouching under it, and lands with a fireball burst.

weaponDescription.text: Short-range powerful flame/arc beam that can be angled. Per-level scaling: beam length + secondary projectiles.

lv1.text: [DRAFT] Short fixed-angle beam, high damage, held while the attack button is down.

lv3.text: [DRAFT] The beam can be angled with directional input and reaches noticeably further.

lv6.text: [DRAFT] The beam splits into a narrow cone at its far end, and secondary fireballs drop from the beam on contact with terrain.

lv10.text: Lv8+: charge for a massive dragon-head projectile.

outlineHex.text: #0A0A12  — shared near-black outline on every sprite; the 3rd of 3 colours + transparency (NES constraint)

silhouette.text: Deferred — silhouette follows from attack + arena design, not before it.

arenaTheme.text: [DRAFT] Moonlit ruin: toppled columns, a cracked floor mosaic, and a background of overgrown arches with light entering from a single high gap.

hazardsLayer1.text: [DRAFT] Patches of darkness drift across the room, reducing visibility to a short radius while the player is inside one.

hazardsLayer2.text: [DRAFT] Larger and more numerous patches, and a shadow clone of an ordinary minion spawns inside each one.

hazardsLayer3.text: [DRAFT] The room blacks out entirely on a slow cycle, leaving only silhouettes and the boss's own outline visible.

attackLayer1.text: Creates darkness zones that slow the player and spawn shadow clones.

attackLayer2.text: [DRAFT] Shadow clones now mimic the boss's previous attack on a short delay, so the pattern arrives twice from two places.

attackLayer3.text: [DRAFT] The boss merges into the darkness and is untargetable while the room is dark, surfacing only to attack.

weaponDescription.text: Throws a dark energy boomerang that steals a small amount of enemy health. Per-level scaling: faster return + more health steal.

lv1.text: [DRAFT] Single boomerang out and back; small health steal on each pass.

lv3.text: [DRAFT] Faster return and increased steal; the boomerang now passes through the first enemy rather than stopping.

lv6.text: Lv7+: creates shadow trails that damage enemies.

lv10.text: Ultimate: temporary “Dark Mode” with increased damage and lifesteal.

arenaTheme.text: [DRAFT] Rolling mill floor: steel plate walls, an overhead crane gantry, and a background of glowing billets on a stalled conveyor.

hazardsLayer1.text: [DRAFT] The overhead crane traverses the room and drops a steel plate at a telegraphed position, which stands as a solid obstacle before being lifted away.

hazardsLayer2.text: [DRAFT] Two plates per pass, and a dropped plate now stays long enough for two to be present at once, splitting the room.

hazardsLayer3.text: [DRAFT] The crane also drags a plate along the floor between drops, sweeping the ground the length of the room.

attackLayer1.text: Fires homing metal blades + deploys temporary shields.

attackLayer2.text: [DRAFT] Blades are fired in a spread and ricochet twice instead of once; the deployed shield now orbits the boss rather than sitting in front of it.

attackLayer3.text: [DRAFT] The shield breaks into blades when destroyed, so removing it is itself an attack the player has to answer.

weaponDescription.text: Throws penetrative metal blades that ricochet multiple times. Per-level scaling: more ricochets + higher damage.

lv1.text: [DRAFT] Single blade, one ricochet, pierces the first enemy hit.

lv3.text: [DRAFT] Two ricochets and increased pierce; blades survive contact with terrain corners.

lv6.text: Lv5+: blades can be recalled early.

lv10.text: Temporary steel armor mode that greatly reduces damage taken.

shared.text: Faint red hue that gets more faint until the attribute subsides. Hot surfaces do damage/flinch/knockback to the player if touched, with hue/damage/flinch/knockback scaling down until Hot fully subsides.

bossVariant.text: Boss/hazard-sourced: player vulnerable. In Blaze Man's arena, lingers 5s after the cause concludes.

weaponVariant.text: Player-sourced (Blaze Wheel): player immune to own Hot; applied to ground/enemies for level-scaled durations.

shared.text: Faint red hue that gets more faint until the attribute subsides. Target is on fire: rapid but weak Hot DPS, no flinch or knockback, scaling down until the duration concludes.

Faint purple hue. DPS applied much less often (~once every 3 seconds); causes flinch.

bossVariant.text: Toxic Cloud: lingering clouds drain health over time and reduce player speed.

weaponVariant.text: Venom Spray: damage over time; weakens enemies.
